notes:
- Made Albums, Recently Added, and Artists scroll more smoothly by reusing artwork and text layers. Reduced row layout work in Songs.
- Unified the library’s Liquid Glass headers and centered their filters. Artwork and rows remain visible through the glass while scrolling, with column headers pinned in Songs.
- Refined hover shapes, search-field focus, and player control alignment.
- Made the Songs playback indicator larger and drew it directly over the thumbnail. Reduced the corner radius of Songs thumbnails.
- Refined synchronized lyrics with staggered line transitions and word-level accents.
- Smoothed the Made by Sound fade when pausing and reduced the CPU work needed to prepare its wave maps.
- Organized localizations under Resources.

Requires macOS 27 or later on Apple silicon. The app archive is ad-hoc signed.
